reasons: The original job required a GPU (`--gres=gpu:1`, and `--partition=gpu`), but the Flux resource section requests only CPU resources (`-N 1 -n 1 -c 8`) with no GPU. On GPU-scheduled systems this may yield a CPU-only allocation and the job can fail or run drastically slower.
issues: If the site expects workloads to be launched under Flux for proper CPU/GPU binding and accounting, consider using `flux run -n 1 -c 8 python nas.py` instead of running `python` directly.
